superresolution.screen.config.options.la: Pause game when configuration screen is open
superresolution.screen.config.options.to: Enable GPU profiling for bottleneck analysis, may affect performance.
When enabled, certain incomplete features (such as DLSS, XeSS) will become available. These features may be unstable, cause unknown issues, or even crash the game. Use with caution.
Only effective in development environment, enables debug UI
Stamps a small square onto every presented frame (white = rendered frame, cyan = generated frame) to visualize the frame generation cadence
When enabled, the mod loads the selected OptiScaler DLL file early during game startup.
Only effective in development environment, enables RenderDoc integration
When enabled, uses the selected algorithm to super resolve the image
Presents the final game image through Vulkan. Restart the game after changing this setting.
Disable "Skip Vulkan Initialization" and restart the game before enabling Vulkan Presentation.
superresolution.screen.config.options.fr: Uses the selected algorithm to generate intermediate frames and boost frame rate. Requires Vulkan Presentation; other requirements depend on the selected algorithm. Active only with a compatible shader pack; disabled when shaders are off or incompatible.
superresolution.screen.config.options.to: Select a low-latency technology to reduce system latency and improve PC responsiveness.
Enable Vulkan Presentation and restart the game to use Low Latency Mode.
Configure NVIDIA Reflex Low Latency. On optimizes system latency. On + Boost further reduces latency and targets CPU-bound scenarios, but may slightly reduce FPS and increase GPU power draw.
Shaders must be adapted for this mod to achieve the best image quality and mod compatibility. Restart the game after changing this option.
Deprecated: motion vectors can improve the super resolution quality of some algorithms (FSR2, SGSR2), but will cost performance

The precision of the internal texture format affects VRAM usage: higher precision means higher usage; lower precision means lower usage.
Note: Too low precision may cause visible color banding.
Select the frame generation algorithm to use. Auto picks whichever one is available.

The mod uses OpenGL-Vulkan interop for super resolution (only for some algorithms, like DLSS). Interop sync mode determines how the mod synchronizes resources between OpenGL and Vulkan.
Low Latency mode processes the current frame directly, synchronizing OpenGL and Vulkan, resulting in lower latency but may reduce low frame rates.
Performance mode allows super resolution on Vulkan to run concurrently with game rendering on OpenGL, improving performance but increasing input lag. This mode is unstable and offers minor gains.
The OptiScaler DLL file to load.

Lower values produce a blurrier image

superresolution.screen.config.hint.perfo: No shader pack is currently active. Vanilla Minecraft has a low graphics load, so super resolution cannot improve performance and may cause frame rate drops. Compatibility in vanilla mode is limited and may cause rendering conflicts with some mods.
superresolution.screen.config.hint.b3d_v: Super Resolution cannot work on the Vulkan backend

The Vulkan graphics backend is currently in use. Because Iris does not support the Vulkan backend yet, Super Resolution cannot enable upscaling or scaling in this environment; you can still open the configuration screen, but all features will be unavailable.
superresolution.screen.config.hint.vulka: This version does not support Vulkan Presentation, Low Latency, or related features.
superresolution.screen.config.hint.shade: The current shader pack has not been adapted for Super Resolution and will run in compatibility mode. This mode may cause blurry visuals, ghosting, reduced performance, and decreased compatibility with other mods.

The current shader pack has not been adapted for Super Resolution, and super resolution is disabled. After enabling "Enable Unadapted Shader Compatibility Mode" and restarting the game, it will run in compatibility mode, which may cause blurry visuals, ghosting, reduced performance, and decreased compatibility with other mods.
